name: Product Image and Video Gallery Slider for WooCommerce
author: ThemesVila

sections.description:
Elevate your WooCommerce product pages with a beautiful, responsive image and video gallery slider.
The WooCommerce Product Gallery Slider plugin lets you display product images and YouTube videos in a sleek, modern slider format. Designed to enhance the customer experience, this plugin adds powerful features like lightbox viewing (Fancybox), image zoom, autoplay videos, and customizable thumbnail navigation.

Live Demo | Watch Video

Key Features:

🎬 YouTube Video Support – Embed YouTube videos alongside your product images.

🖼️ Image Slider – Slick slider integration for smooth transitions between images and videos.

⚡ Lazy Loading – Load content only when needed, improving page speed.

🔲 3 Layout Styles – Choose between Classic, Horizontal, and Vertical gallery layouts.

🔍 Zoom Effect – Let users zoom into product images for detailed views.

💡 Lightbox (Fancybox) – Click to view images and videos in an elegant popup.

🧭 Thumbnail Navigation – Easily navigate the gallery with thumbnails.

📱 Mobile Responsive – Optimized for all screen sizes and devices.

⚙️ Customizable Layout – Choose between horizontal or vertical thumbnail layouts.

Whether you’re selling fashion, electronics, or digital products, this plugin helps your customers better understand your offerings—boosting trust and conversions.

Works seamlessly with most themes and the latest versions of WooCommerce.

Features

✅ Easy Installation
✅ Plug and Play
✅ Beautiful Product Gallery
✅ Three Layout Style
✅ Used Facny Lightbox for Popup Image
✅ Video Gallery Supported
✅ Lightweight Plugin
✅ Advance Plugin Setting
✅ Unlimited Color Options
✅ And Much More
sections.installation:
1. Upload product-gallery-slider-for-wc/wp-content/plugins/` directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress
